successCriteria.description: The list read endpoint returns HTTP 200 with the array produced by leaveService.list(actor, parsedQuery), where actor is resolved from request.user and parsedQuery is the validated LeaveRequestQueryParams.
The single-read endpoint returns HTTP 200 with the LeaveRequest produced by leaveService.getById(actor, id), where id is read from the route params and actor is resolved from request.user.

Wire query strings are parsed and validated before reaching the service: status and leaveTypeCode are rejected with ValidationError unless they are members of LeaveStatus / LeaveTypeCode; the four date bounds are converted via a toDate-style helper that throws ValidationError on invalid dates; limit and offset are parsed as integers when present and left undefined when absent.
The actor is always derived from request.user via the existing resolveActor helper; no client-supplied actor/employee id is accepted for either read endpoint.

Any AppError thrown by parsing or the service is mapped through the existing sendError helper inside a try/catch that also logs via request.log.error, preserving the { error, code } contract and status codes.

constraints: Do not mount any new routes in src/app.ts — leaveRoutes is already mounted; only add handlers inside src/modules/leave/leave.routes.ts.
Do not implement or modify leaveService.list / getById or the repository findByQuery — they are owned by sibling sub-phase 6.1 and already exist; this sub-phase only consumes them.
Reuse the existing resolveActor, sendError, and the toDate helper pattern from parseCreateBody rather than introducing parallel helpers.
No unit/integration test files may be created in this sub-phase (owned by sibling 6.3); the gate must not require test existence or coverage.
outOfScope: Sub-phase 6.1 — Repository findByQuery employeeIds + Service list/getById (src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts, src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts).
Sub-phase 6.3 — Tests for leave reads (leave.repository.test.ts, leave.service.test.ts, leave.routes.test.ts); no test files or coverage requirements here.
Any change to src/app.ts route mounting or to the shared types/enums in src/shared/types/index.ts.

entityInvariants.invariant: A parsed query object passed to the service must contain only typed values: status/leaveTypeCode as enum members, the four date bounds as Date, limit/offset as integers or undefined, and must never carry a client-supplied employeeIds (visibility scope is resolved by the service from the actor).
The actor for read operations is derived solely from request.user via resolveActor and is never synthesized from query/body/param input.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Requires an authenticated actor resolved from request.user; visibility scope is enforced inside the service by role (EMPLOYEE self-only, MANAGER self+direct reports, ADMIN all).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read-only; returns LeaveRequest[] or throws AppError (UnauthorizedError/ForbiddenError) mapped via sendError.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Requires an authenticated actor resolved from request.user; out-of-scope requests are indistinguishable from missing (NotFoundError).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read-only; returns LeaveRequest or throws NotFoundError/UnauthorizedError mapped via sendError.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The parsed query object must conform to the LeaveRequestQueryParams shape (status/leaveTypeCode enums, Date bounds, integer limit/offset) declared in src/shared/types/index.ts.
Enum membership validation must match the exact LeaveStatus and LeaveTypeCode values defined in src/shared/types/index.ts.
Date parsing must mirror the toDate(value, field) helper semantics in parseCreateBody (Date passthrough, string/number required, invalid date → ValidationError).
Error mapping must reuse sendError and the AppError subclasses (ValidationError 400, UnauthorizedError 401, NotFoundError 404) defined in src/shared/errors/index.ts.
Handlers must call leaveService.list(actor, query) and leaveService.getById(actor, id) with the exact signatures declared in ILeaveService.

integrationPoints.why: The read handlers delegate to these already-implemented service methods; the route layer must not re-implement visibility or data access.
Enum membership validation and the parsed query shape are defined here.
sendError maps these typed errors to the { error, code } HTTP contract.
